body: Delivery attack: accept gates 2,4,5,6; modify 1 and 3. Fork 1 should not consume a milestone comparing a clever neutral launcher unless one-click is a contractual requirement—it isn't. Default now to separate-domain Stage + its own fullscreen click; prototype only the exact two-step path and manual fallback. The launcher alternative couples activation, popup, origin transition, auth, and SW at highest demo risk. Fork 2's timing/size noninterference is not realistically provable with ordinary tests; require architectural reachability denial plus bounded differential traces, not absolute timing equality. Fork 3 choose existing authenticated Console -> pair phone -> open public Stage for MVP; phone-first guest PC adds device-authorization/bootstrap UX and support surface without needed value. Cold-start rehearsal still required. Staffing/order: resolve coordinator tech and schemas in WP1; build prepared-deck manual vertical slice and authoritative coordinator in parallel; no remote pairing UI until protocol fault harness passes. Do not staff Window Management or live-public AI until core rehearses. Estimated production-path guarded pilot: 13-16 weeks with 5 core FTE + part-time privacy/ops; 3 generalists means 20-26 weeks or remove live-public AI and auto-placement.
